snippet.title: Tower of Gold trailer - Remar Games
snippet.description:
Download: https://www.remargames.se/tower.php
Download as donationware on itch.io: https://remar-games.itch.io/tower-of-gold
My Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/remargames

Tower of Gold is a massive EGA DOS-style puzzle/platforming adventure featuring a first-person overworld and lots of secrets! The game and its soundtrack were mainly inspired by Equinox for the SNES.

As usual, YouTube changed this trailer to 30 FPS so it looks a bit choppy. You can watch or download the original video on my homepage.
